observation.command: ls -la /var/lib/dpkg/lock* /var/lib/apt/lists/lock 2>/dev/null; echo "--- any leftover apt/dpkg procs ---"; ps aux | grep -E "apt-get|dpkg|http" | grep -v grep | head; echo "--- test apt update ---"; timeout 60 apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "update rc=$?"
